ClickHouse Columnar ZSTD Trace Storage vs. Elasticsearch Inverted-Index Log Footprint Benchmarks

workload.traffic_scale: 50,000,000 Enterprise Agent & RAG Requests / Month (Avg 12K input tokens + 600 output tokens)
workload.failure_profile: 3.5% of requests suffer silent RAG hallucination, low-confidence token entropy spikes, or MCP tool retries
workload.otel_conventions: OpenTelemetry GenAI Semantic Conventions v1.30+ (gen_ai.system, gen_ai.usage.*, gen_ai.server.time_to_first_token)

tiers.name: Tier 1: 原始无结构化 stdout/JSON 全量落盘 Elasticsearch (无语义埋点 · 月烧 $48k 存储 · 0% 自动发现幻觉)
tiers.name_en: Tier 1: Unstructured Raw JSON/stdout to Elasticsearch (0% Eval Recall · $48k/mo Storage Bloat)
tiers.telemetry_and_store: Raw HTTP payload dump to Elasticsearch inverted index without OTel GenAI span structure or PII scrubbing
tiers.sampling_and_eval_strategy: Manual post-incident grep only; zero automated hallucination or drift scoring
tiers.recommended_for: Never recommended for production AI; inverted-index full-text indexing on 12K prompts explodes storage bills and leaks PII.

tiers.name: Tier 2: 100% 全量同步阻塞式 LLM-as-a-Judge 质检 (延迟暴涨 +640ms · 质检算力费反超主模型)
tiers.name_en: Tier 2: 100% Synchronous Inline LLM-as-a-Judge Gate (+640ms Latency · $82k/mo Judge Bill)
tiers.telemetry_and_store: Logs every request + blocks response on synchronous 8B/70B faithfulness & toxicity judge
tiers.sampling_and_eval_strategy: 100% synchronous evaluation on all 50M requests (96.5% of which are normal healthy requests)
tiers.recommended_for: Offline small-scale pre-release benchmarks only; too slow (+640ms) and expensive ($82k/mo) for 50M live requests.

tiers.name: Tier 3: OpenTelemetry GenAI 语义追踪 + ClickHouse ZSTD 列存 + 5% 均匀随机异步抽样 (漏检 81.5% 长尾故障)
tiers.name_en: Tier 3: OTel GenAI Spans + ClickHouse Columnar ZSTD + 5% Uniform Random Async Judge
tiers.telemetry_and_store: OTel GenAI spans exported asynchronously to ClickHouse ZSTD (12x compression) + Prometheus Exemplars
tiers.sampling_and_eval_strategy: Uniform 5% random sampling sent to async LLM Judge (misses 95% of rare tail failures!)
tiers.recommended_for: Baseline telemetry and cost/latency dashboards where rare silent failure attribution is not yet required.

tiers.name: Tier 4: OTel GenAI + 尾部自适应异常采样 (高熵/低精排分/工具重试 100% 必采 + 2% 基线) + 流式 PII 脱敏
tiers.name_en: Tier 4: OTel GenAI + Tail-Based Adaptive Anomaly Sampling (94.6% Failure Recall at 6.8% Eval Volume) + PII Guard
tiers.telemetry_and_store: OTel GenAI + ClickHouse ZSTD + Presidio/GLiNER collector-side PII redaction + UMAP/Centroid embedding drift
tiers.sampling_and_eval_strategy: Tail-based trigger: 100% async Judge on (Token Entropy > 1.4 | Rerank < 0.45 | Tool Retry | TTFT Breach) + 2% random baseline
tiers.recommended_for: Enterprise production RAG, Multi-Agent, and Coding platforms requiring >94% silent failure capture at <$6k/mo.
